title: automodel: A Skill for Agentic Model Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.24347v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The search for better models, whether expressed as analytical equations or neural architectures, has increasingly shifted from manual design toward data-driven automation. While a multitude of algorithms exist, ranging from exhaustive search to AlphaEvolve, recent advances in general-purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex raise the question: could providing such systems with a "model discovery recipe" be enough to discover or improve models? We present automodel, an agent skill for general model discovery. With case studies in astrophysics, cardiovascular dynamics, precision agriculture, traffic flow, and vehicle tire dynamics, we show how commercial agents equipped with automodel can successfully identify novel and scientifically-relevant models. Our findings suggest that encoding model-discovery methodology as a portable agent skill can provide a simple, interactive, powerful and broadly applicable alternative to do

translated_title: automodel：一种用于智能体模型发现的技能
translated_abstract: 寻找更好的模型——无论是以解析方程还是神经架构的形式表达——已经越来越多地从人工设计转向数据驱动的自动化。尽管存在大量算法，从穷举搜索到 AlphaEvolve，但诸如 Claude Code 和 OpenAI Codex 等通用编码智能体的最新进展提出了一个问题：为这类系统提供一份“模型发现配方”是否足以发现或改进模型？我们提出了 automodel，一种面向通用模型发现的智能体技能。通过在天体物理学、心血管动力学、精准农业、交通流和车辆轮胎动力学等领域的案例研究，我们展示了配备 automodel 的商业智能体能够成功识别新颖且具有科学意义的模型。我们的研究结果表明，将模型发现方法编码为可移植的智能体技能，可以提供一种简单、交互式、强大且广泛适用的模型发现替代方案。
tldr: 提出 automodel 智能体技能，将模型发现方法编码为可移植的技能，使商业编码智能体能够自动发现或改进跨越多个科学领域的新颖模型。
en_tdlr: automodel encodes model-discovery methodology as a portable agent skill, enabling commercial coding agents to automatically discover novel and scientifically relevant models across diverse domains.
